feeds.title: Motionographer
feeds.description: Motionographer shares inspiring work and important news for the motion design, animation, and visual effects communities. Motionographer is a leading source of inspiration, covering only the best short films, commercial work, music videos, student work, and industry news.

feeds.title: Story Struggles
feeds.description: Story struggles depict an artist's journey and experiences they share here. I created Story Struggles as an online collection of articles and art about story, film, storyboarding, and visual storytelling. I'm Joscha. I'm an Amsterdam-based story artist. I've been drawing for as long as I can remember.

feeds.title: Parka Blogs
feeds.description: Parka Blog features thousands of reviews for art supplies, products, and art books relating to anime, comics, movies, and illustrations. The purpose of the reviews is to help readers make informed purchases. The mission statement of the blog is to make sure you know exactly what you're buying.

feeds.title: Storyboard Artists Guide
feeds.description: Explore the latest Artist News, Updates, and stories from Storyboard Artists Guide. Features truthful, no-holds-barred, commentary analysis of the challenges and issues affecting the storyboard/graphic arts industry and told from the viewpoint of professionals with decades of experience in successfully navigating this constantly evolving commercial environment.

feeds.title: Celtx Blog » Storyboard
feeds.description: The Celtx Blog brings to you all the resources you need as a Storyboard artist. Find comprehensive articles on how to create and pitch storyboards and many other insightful reads. Our mission at Celtx is to provide aspiring writers with script writing software to help streamline the entire process with imagination, innovation and originality.

feeds.title: Dylan Shearsby
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dylan Shearsby and this is my sketchbook. I post work, practice, and other sketches here. You can find storyboards, keyframes, before & after comparisons, and more. I am a storyboard and visual artist for the ad & entertainment industries.

feeds.title: Cartoon Brew
feeds.description: Cartoon Brew reports the latest news, trends, and ideas in animation to artists, entertainment execs, and cartoon aficionados. It is the Internet's leading source for animation news and commentary. The site covers a wide range of topics, from cutting-edge computer animation and visual effects for both television and film, to classical techniques like hand-drawn and stop motion.

feeds.title: AnimSchool Blog
feeds.description: AnimSchool is the premiere online school for the broader world of 3D animation. AnimSchool instructors are 3D animation pros by day, and teach animation, modeling and rigging after work. Students at AnimSchool learn how to make characters and how to move characters.#animationtutorial

feeds.title: Animation Mentor Blog
feeds.description: The Animation Mentor blog is packed with animation tips, animation news, characters, and more. It teaches character and creature animation in a real-world production environment. Programs are designed and taught by top industry animators. Animation Mentor is an animation school providing industry professionals the help and expertise they want to accelerate their careers in animation.

feeds.title: Animation Magazine
feeds.description: Animation Magazine is one of the largest animation websites and international magazines in the world devoted to breaking daily news and in-depth articles and profiles about animated films, TV series, cartoons, new media, visual effects, and CG software and technologies. Read our featured articles covering TV, Streaming and Anime.

feeds.title: Storyboard Art Blog
feeds.description: Check out recent posts from Storyboard Art, an established resource for visual story-telling training. Learn techniques, tips & tricks to showcase your art better. Our tutorials provide in-depth analysis of visual storytelling techniques and advanced concepts to help you improve and succeed as a storyboard artist.

feeds.title: Greg Banning Blog
feeds.description: Greg Banning is an artist-illustrator who has built his career on versatility. Greg has worked as a storyboard artist in the world of advertising for 25 years. In this blog, he packs his artwork - courtroom scenes, doodles, vector storyboards, and other cool stuff.

feeds.title: The Plot Blog
feeds.description: The Plot Blog delivers news, inspiration, tip & Tricks, and more resources to help you storyboard online. Know where to find the best video editing software, stock music, latest short films, new equipment, and more. The Plot is a free storyboard software and online storyboard creator that help you collaborate with your team without hassle.

feeds.title: Speaker Deck Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of Speaker Deck. Check out the latest features, trending decks, and recommendations. Speaker Deck is an online service that helps you create and share presentations hassle-free. Just upload the slides as a PDF and Speaker Deck takes care of everything else.

feeds.title: Matt Jones Animation
feeds.description: Matt Jones shares his art in this blog covering videos and articles on sketching, animation, painting, and drawing. Marvel at wonderful concept art and original designs. Matt is an animation director, writer, storyboard artist, and designer.

feeds.title: StoryBoard Quick Insider Blog
feeds.description: StoryBoard Quick Insider Blog from Power Production gives storyboarding tips, software information, and technical insight into creating visually appealing storyboards. PowerProduction Company develops and publishes award-winning production software and serves the Hollywood and the media production community.

feeds.title: Toon Boom Animation Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news from Toon Boom Animation in our Newsfeed. With years of incomparable experience, Toon Boom's award-winning software is the global standard for animation and storyboarding. Our mission at Toon Boom is to build innovative software solutions that provide powerful storyboarding, offer animation capabilities and streamline the production process for artists, studios, and students.

feeds.title: On Animation
feeds.description: On Animation blog provides a daily dose of inspiration carefully curated for the animation artist. It is a daily blog about animation and the art of filmmaking. Discover insights on Production art, short films, insights, analysis, inspiration, and passionate ramblings.
